module.purpose: Implements Zustand's persist middleware that transparently syncs store state with an external storage backend (e.g. localStorage). It provides rehydration on initialization, automatic persistence on state changes, version-based migration, partialize/merge customization, SSR safety, hydration lifecycle hooks, and concurrent-rehydrate race protection.
module.summary: This file defines the persist middleware for the Zustand state management library. It exports a `persist` function that wraps a state creator to automatically persist state changes and rehydrate from storage on creation. Key capabilities include: configurable storage via `PersistStorage`/`StateStorage` interfaces; a `createJSONStorage` factory that adapts raw storage (like `window.localStorage`) into JSON-aware storage with optional reviver/replacer; `PersistOptions` for naming, partialize, version, migrate, merge, skipHydration, and onRehydrateStorage callbacks; a Thenable helper (`toThenable`) that unifies synchronous and Promise-based storage responses; race-safe rehydration via a `hydrationVersion` counter; and an augmented store API exposing `persist.setOptions`, `clearStorage`, `rehydrate`, `hasHydrated`, `onHydrate`, `onFinishHydration`, and `getOptions`. Type-level plumbing uses a `'zustand/persist'` mutator to extend the store type with a `persist` namespace while preserving `setState` overload signatures.
module.businessContext: Persisting client state across page reloads is foundational for modern web apps (carts, auth tokens, UI preferences). If this middleware fails, users lose their session and unsaved state on every refresh, breaking core UX and often requiring re-authentication.

typeShapes.name: JsonStorageOptions
PersistOptions
typeShapes.shape:
/** Name of the storage (must be unique) */
  name: string
  /**
   * Use a custom persist storage.
   *
   * Combining `createJSONStorage` helps creating a persist storage
   * with JSON.parse and JSON.stringify.
   *
   * @default createJSONStorage(() => window.localStorage)
   */
  storage?: PersistStorage<PersistedState, PersistReturn> | undefined
  /**
   * Filter the persisted value.
   *
   * @params state The state's value
   */
  partialize?: (state: S) => PersistedState
  /**
   * A function returning another (optional) function.
   * The main function will be called before the state rehydration.
   * The returned function will be called after the state rehydration or when an error occurred.
   */
  onRehydrateStorage?: (
    state: S,
  ) => ((state?: S, error?: unknown) => void) | void
  /**
   * If the stored state's version mismatch the one specified here, the storage will not be used.
   * This is useful when adding a breaking change to your store.
   */
  version?: number
  /**
   * A function to perform persisted state migration.
   * This function will be called when persisted state versions mismatch with the one specified here.
   */
  migrate?: (
    persistedState: unknown,
    version: number,
  ) => PersistedState | Promise<PersistedState>
  /**
   * A function to perform custom hydration merges when combining the stored state with the current one.
   * By default, this function does a shallow merge.
   */
  merge?: (persistedState: unknown, currentState: S) => S

  /**
   * An optional boolean that will prevent the persist middleware from triggering hydration on initialization,
   * This allows you to call `rehydrate()` at a specific point in your apps rendering life-cycle.
   *
   * This is useful in SSR application.
   *
   * @default false
   */
  skipHydration?: boolean

edgeCases.inputShape: getStorage throws (e.g., SSR where window.localStorage undefined)
edgeCases.behavior: createJSONStorage catches and returns undefined; persist middleware then takes the !storage branch, calling config with a set wrapper that warns to console.
parse returns null; hydrate treats null deserializedStorageValue as falsy and returns [false, undefined], merging undefined (no change).
getItem returns str.then(parse); hydrate chains a Thenable on it.

edgeCases.behavior: Migration awaited; result forwarded as [true, result].
console.error logged; no migration; deserializedStorageValue.state is not used (fallthrough returns [false, undefined]).
hydrationVersion increments; stale callbacks short-circuit when currentVersion !== hydrationVersion.
Initial hydrate() call skipped; user must call api.persist.rehydrate() manually.

assumptions.description: Assumes a browser-like environment with window.localStorage available at default storage factory call.
createJSONStorage caller may rely on SSR safety — getStorage may throw when window is undefined.
Assumes Promise is available (used in instanceof Promise checks).
Assumes options.storage, when provided, implements PersistStorage contract with getItem/setItem/removeItem.
Assumes options.partialize returns a serializable subset of state suitable for JSON.stringify.
Assumes options.merge and options.migrate (if provided) conform to documented signatures.
State from storage is merged into configResult before initial render via getInitialState assignment.
Stored JSON must conform to StorageValue<S> = { state: S, version?: number }; non-numeric version is treated as no-version (always matches).
